title: Fatchuck cheekchops
html_source: Chuck refers to meat from the shoulder of a cow or another animal. Chop is a term for both a cut of meat generally containing rib and, in the plural, one’s jaw or mouth. Together with bonham, these words create an impression of a fat, porcine man.
